exposure: maternal serum and fetal cord blood BDNF levels
cohort: Pregnant women divided into three groups based on MSAF and fetal distress
finding: While there was no significant difference in BDNF levels between groups with and without MSAF alone, both maternal serum and fetal cord blood BDNF levels were significantly lower when fetal distress occurred in the presence of MSAF.
mod_finding: This study found that lower BDNF levels were associated with fetal distress and meconium-stained amniotic fluid, which may necessitate emergency cesarean section.
